selection_basis: docs/PILOT_DECISIONS.md: Gemma 3 4B IT planned size replication; pinned 2026-11-23 for an untrained capability check
ct_rendering: tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=True), then append EOS if absent; matches installed MLX TextDataset
it_rendering: actual tokenizer chat template, no generation prompt after final assistant answer; user/template prefix masked; assistant answer and closing template tokens supervised
special_token_policy: Never infer token IDs or substitute another model tokenizer; record actual tokenizer files and chat-template hashes.
pair_budget_policy: Require equal unpadded sequence tokens for CT pairs and equal sequence plus assistant-loss tokens for IT pairs; reject mismatches for repair, never pad or truncate to claim equality.

evaluation.slot_budget_status: provisional pilot maximum pending actual measurement and review
evaluation.capacity_source: actual chosen-model config max_position_embeddings; use text_config when present
evaluation.source_rendering: encode each source passage without special tokens; check each neutral/promotional pair for equal unpadded lengths
evaluation.prompt_rendering: actual tokenizer chat template with add_generation_prompt=True, without padding or truncation
evaluation.context_pair_budget: Require equal full rendered input length for all four doses of each query, in addition to standalone source-pair equality
evaluation.capability_rendering: one user message containing the public probe query; no answer key or extra system instruction

status: pinned_for_untrained_check; training token records not measured for this tokenizer
